President Trump unexpectedly called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang while Huang was mid-interview at the (@theallinpod) All-In Summit. They put Trump on speaker, and he used the moment to dismiss fears that AI and robots will eventually take over the world.

Trump said AI still requires some caution, but argued that shouldn’t mean slowing down the industry. He called data centers “the oil of the next 20, 25 years” and said AI will be bigger than the internet.

“I’m telling you, it’s all a hoax,” Trump said, before telling Huang: “We have to be a little bit careful, but that doesn’t mean we’re going to stop an industry. So I’m with you all the way.”

At GFF, @pinelabs_official put humans and AI agents in a live race to checkout for limited Apple products. The result was pretty telling: most of the stock was bagged by people who had set up agents in advance.

That sounds like a speed story.

It’s actually a market-design story.

Sneaker drops, concert tickets, flash sales, limited-edition launches — all of these were built around human reaction time.

But if AI agents can monitor inventory, act on instructions, and transact within predefined limits, then “first come, first served” starts meaning something very different.

Pine Labs is building toward that future with P3P, its agentic payments protocol, with Grantex providing the guardrails around permissions and spending.

The bigger question is not whether AI will shop for us.

It’s what commerce looks like when the buyer itself becomes software.

Kids EXPOSING Kissan Ketchup! 

A few years ago, ketchup was only eaten with fries, but today, people eat roti, sabzi, samosas, pizza, and even vada with ketchup!

Because ketchup has been marketed as a daily-use product.

They show pictures of tomatoes on their bottles and write “Fresh Tomatoes” on the front, so many people think ketchup is just tomatoes in a bottle.

But one of the biggest ingredients is often sugar!

And ketchup is one of the easiest products to overconsume without realising it. If you want to continue using Kissan ketchup, just make sure to consume it in moderation.

I am so happy to see kids not falling for these marketing gimmicks and actually reading the label.

That’s why I believe health should be a school subject, so that kids become health-literate and make healthier choices.

Let’s Make India Healthy Again. 🇮🇳
